newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 PLUNGES ANEW AS T-BONDS PLUMMET.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 PLUNGES ANEW AS T-BONDS PLUMMET.

text.p: The FTSE 100 dived afresh as T-bonds plunged and the London market braced for a sharply lower opening on the Dow.

"The S&P futures are indicating more than 100 points off the Dow at the New York opening and although they are not always a brilliant indicator, we are seeing the T-bonds dropping like a stone," said one dealer.

The index was 76.6 points off at 5,010.2 by 1248 GMT, having fallen sharply earlier in the session on profit-taking and as players switched from banks and drug stocks to engineers, builders and smaller capitalised stocks.
